before0000000000.description:
You look for creatures hidden from you within 10 squares that you have line of effect to. Make an Intuition test using the Search skill; each hidden creature in range makes an Agility test using the Hide skill to oppose it. If your total is higher than a hidden creature's, they are no longer hidden from you.

As part of this maneuver, you can point out any creature you find to your allies within 10 squares, and a creature hidden from your allies but not from you can be pointed out without a test.

@UUID[Compendium.draw-steel-combat-tools.rules.JournalEntry.DSCTrulesJournal.JournalEntryPage.DSCTfullHiding00]{Full rules: Hiding and Sneaking}

Combat Tools: the Search button on this card rolls the tests, reveals whoever you beat, and offers to point them out to allies within 10 squares.
